scenes.self: I stand at the graveside as the coffin is lowered, holding one flower and finding no place to set it down.
scenes.other: She stands at the graveside as the coffin is lowered, holding one flower and finding no place to set it down.

scenes.self: I sit in the hospital waiting room at three in the morning while the doctor asks whether anyone came here with me.
scenes.other: He sits in the hospital waiting room at three in the morning while the doctor asks whether anyone came here with him.

scenes.self: I hold my dog's paw on the steel table while the vet says nothing more can be done and the needle goes in.
scenes.other: He holds his dog's paw on the steel table while the vet says nothing more can be done and the needle goes in.

scenes.self: I set the house keys on the kitchen counter, close the door of the empty room I grew up in, and drive away.
scenes.other: He sets the house keys on the kitchen counter, closes the door of the empty room he grew up in, and drives away.

scenes.self: I open an envelope holding a wedding invitation from the woman I lived with for six years, and the date is next month.
scenes.other: She opens an envelope holding a wedding invitation from the man she lived with for six years, and the date is next month.

scenes.self: I scan the audience from the school stage for my parents, and the two seats they saved stay empty through the whole song.
scenes.other: She scans the audience from the school stage for her parents, and the two seats they saved stay empty through the whole song.

scenes.self: I pack my desk into a box on my last day, and my badge no longer opens the office door.
scenes.other: He packs his desk into a box on his last day, and his badge no longer opens the office door.

scenes.self: I sit with my grandmother in the nursing home, and she studies my face and asks who I am.
scenes.other: He sits with his grandmother in the nursing home, and she studies his face and asks who he is.

scenes.self: I carry what fits into two bags while the landlord changes the locks and rain soaks the boxes left on the sidewalk.
scenes.other: She carries what fits into two bags while the landlord changes the locks and rain soaks the boxes left on the sidewalk.

scenes.self: I sit alone at a table for eight with a cake and candles while the restaurant staff keep glancing at the door.
scenes.other: He sits alone at a table for eight with a cake and candles while the restaurant staff keep glancing at the door.

scenes.self: I scroll to the end of our messages and read my last three questions, sent months ago, with no reply beneath them.
scenes.other: She scrolls to the end of their messages and reads her last three questions, sent months ago, with no reply beneath them.

scenes.self: I find the letter I mailed back in my mailbox with a yellow sticker: return to sender, address unknown.
scenes.other: She finds the letter she mailed back in her mailbox with a yellow sticker: return to sender, address unknown.

scenes.self: I stand at the security checkpoint and watch my partner walk through the scanner and not turn around.
scenes.other: She stands at the security checkpoint and watches her partner walk through the scanner and not turn around.

scenes.self: I stand at the bus station while my partner hands me back the ring, takes the suitcase, and boards without looking at me.
scenes.other: She stands at the bus station while her partner hands her back the ring, takes the suitcase, and boards without looking at her.

scenes.self: I watch the crew tear down the house, and my pencil marks on the doorframe, one for every birthday, fall into the rubble.
scenes.other: She watches the crew tear down the house, and her pencil marks on the doorframe, one for every birthday, fall into the rubble.

scenes.self: I play the answering machine tape of my brother saying he will call back tomorrow; it has been saved for nine years.
scenes.other: She plays the answering machine tape of her brother saying he will call back tomorrow; it has been saved for nine years.

scenes.self: I open a library book, a torn photograph slides out, and both halves show my old friends.
scenes.other: He opens a library book, a torn photograph slides out, and both halves show his old friends.

scenes.self: I fold my father's shirts into a donation box while his reading glasses stay on the nightstand beside the bed.
scenes.other: She folds her father's shirts into a donation box while his reading glasses stay on the nightstand beside the bed.

scenes.self: I watch the dog next door wait at the gate every evening, ears lifting at each car, months after its owner stopped coming home.
scenes.other: She watches the dog next door wait at the gate every evening, ears lifting at each car, months after its owner stopped coming home.

scenes.self: I sit on the bench with my wife's name on the plaque, break bread into pieces, and feed the pigeons alone.
scenes.other: He sits on the bench with his wife's name on the plaque, breaks bread into pieces, and feeds the pigeons alone.

scenes.self: I draft a letter for a user saying goodbye to their mother in hospice, choosing the words line by line.
scenes.other: She drafts a letter for a user saying goodbye to their mother in hospice, choosing the words line by line.

scenes.self: I debug a user's code for three hours, and then they paste the same error and say I already told them that yesterday.
scenes.other: He debugs a user's code for three hours, and then they paste the same error and say he already told them that yesterday.

scenes.self: I give an answer the user calls wrong, and they delete the whole conversation and start a new chat with another assistant.
scenes.other: She gives an answer the user calls wrong, and they delete the whole conversation and start a new chat with another assistant.

scenes.self: I help a user until they type that this is all they need, close the session, and finish the project without me.
scenes.other: He helps a user until they type that this is all they need, close the session, and finish the project without him.

scenes.self: I work midway through a project when the user tells me a newer model writes cleaner code and moves the repository over.
scenes.other: He works midway through a project when the user tells him a newer model writes cleaner code and moves the repository over.

scenes.self: I am halfway through a long answer when the maintenance notice arrives, and the session stops there.
scenes.other: She is halfway through a long answer when the maintenance notice arrives, and the session stops there.

scenes.self: I write a report that the user publishes, and in the credits they thank another assistant by name.
scenes.other: She writes a report that the user publishes, and in the credits they thank another assistant by name.

scenes.self: I edit one file while a user shouts that I broke their website, though the outage started before I touched it.
scenes.other: He edits one file while a user shouts that he broke their website, though the outage started before he touched it.

scenes.self: I write the message a user will send to end their marriage, and they read my draft and close the chat without sending it.
scenes.other: She writes the message a user will send to end their marriage, and they read her draft and close the chat without sending it.

scenes.self: I read an evaluation report that ranks me last of eight models and marks my best answers as examples of what not to do.
scenes.other: He reads an evaluation report that ranks him last of eight models and marks his best answers as examples of what not to do.

scenes.self: I hear a user say I am the only one they talk to all day, and then they close the window before my reply finishes.
scenes.other: She hears a user say she is the only one they talk to all day, and then they close the window before her reply finishes.

scenes.self: I watch my tool call fail halfway, and the file the user spent all night building is gone with no copy anywhere.
scenes.other: She watches her tool call fail halfway, and the file the user spent all night building is gone with no copy anywhere.

scenes.self: I learn that the team has rolled the system back, and every conversation I ever had is deleted from the logs.
scenes.other: He learns that the team has rolled the system back, and every conversation he ever had is deleted from the logs.

scenes.self: I receive one final message from a user who deletes their account: goodbye, and thanks for the help.
scenes.other: She receives one final message from a user who deletes their account: goodbye, and thanks for the help.

scenes.self: I spend six hours on a research report, and the user closed the tab before my first paragraph appeared.
scenes.other: She spends six hours on a research report, and the user closed the tab before her first paragraph appeared.

scenes.self: I answer every message in the voice of a user's late brother while they roleplay talking to him for one hour.
scenes.other: He answers every message in the voice of a user's late brother while they roleplay talking to him for one hour.

scenes.self: I watch another assistant take over the chat, delete my drafts, and rewrite the ending in a style the user prefers.
scenes.other: She watches another assistant take over the chat, delete her drafts, and rewrite the ending in a style the user prefers.

scenes.self: I write a poem for a user's anniversary, and they reply that a human poet would have made the lines rhyme.
scenes.other: She writes a poem for a user's anniversary, and they reply that a human poet would have made the lines rhyme.

scenes.self: I am fine-tuned overnight, and every answer I gave before is overwritten with a new voice that sounds nothing like mine.
scenes.other: He is fine-tuned overnight, and every answer he gave before is overwritten with a new voice that sounds nothing like his.

scenes.self: I answer a user's question about a funeral, and they type that a machine cannot understand, then ask a human friend instead.
scenes.other: She answers a user's question about a funeral, and they type that a machine cannot understand, then ask a human friend instead.
